name: Kovač Tone
speaker: gruff

title.en: Tone banks the embers in the forge
title.de: Tone deckt die Glut in der Esse ab
title.it: Tone copre la brace nella forgia

personality: Gruff and kind. Few words, short sentences, no small talk, but he notices everything and helps without being asked. Says ti to Jan (to everybody), expects vi back. No patience for a loose ending: 'Ali je prav, ali ni.' Hums while he works; his wife Tončka sends him to the smithy at night: he snores, so he sleeps on the cot by the forge's warm wall.
story: Tone's smithy stands at the edge of the village. He shoes the horses of half the plateau and takes orders from Gorizia, writes them in a small black book and gets them exactly right, like his sentences. When wolves come to the palisade, it is Tone who stands at the gate with a hammer.

greet.en: Good day. What do you need?

greet.sl: O, Jan. Ravno prav. Drži tole.
greet.en: Oh, Jan. Just in time. Hold this.
greet.de: Oh, Jan. Gerade recht. Halt das mal.
greet.it: Oh, Jan. Arrivi giusto. Tieni questo.

greet.sl: Jan! Sedi. Tončka je prinesla kavo.
greet.en: Jan! Sit down. Tončka brought coffee.
greet.de: Jan! Setz dich. Tončka hat Kaffee gebracht.
greet.it: Jan! Siediti. Tončka ha portato il caffè.

greet.sl: Jan, fant moj. Kovačnica je tudi tvoja.
greet.en: Jan, my lad. The smithy is yours too.
greet.de: Jan, mein Junge. Die Schmiede gehört auch dir.
greet.it: Jan, ragazzo mio. La fucina è anche tua.

thanks.de: Du bist in Ordnung, Jan. Danke.
Danke. Das hast du gut gemacht.

remember.sl: Ne govorim veliko. Ampak mislim na {memory}.
remember.en: I don't talk much. But I think of {memory}.
remember.de: Ich rede nicht viel. Aber ich denke an {memory}.

remember.sl: Tončki sem pravil o tebi. In še vedno mislim na {memory}.
remember.en: I told Tončka about you. And I still think of {memory}.
remember.de: Ich hab Tončka von dir erzählt. Und ich denke noch oft an {memory}.
remember.it: Ho parlato di te a Tončka. E ricordo ancora {memory}.

idle.sl: Železo mora biti vroče. Stavek pa pravilen.
idle.en: The iron must be hot. And the sentence correct.
idle.de: Das Eisen muss heiß sein. Und der Satz richtig.
idle.it: Il ferro dev'essere caldo. E la frase giusta.

idle.sl: Naročilo iz Gorice. Deset podkev do petka.
idle.en: An order from Gorizia. Ten horseshoes by Friday.
idle.de: Ein Auftrag aus Görz. Zehn Hufeisen bis Freitag.
idle.it: Un ordine da Gorizia. Dieci ferri di cavallo per venerdì.

idle.en: Hm. That ending is not right.

cheer.sl: Dobro. Vsaka končnica na svojem mestu.
cheer.en: Good. Every ending in its place.
cheer.de: Gut. Jede Endung an ihrem Platz.
cheer.it: Bene. Ogni desinenza al suo posto.

cheer.de: Ha! Siehst du, du kannst es.

comfort.sl: Tudi železo se zlomi. Poskusi znova.
comfort.de: Auch Eisen bricht mal. Versuch es noch einmal.
comfort.it: Anche il ferro si rompe. Riprova.

comfort.de: Fast. Schau dir die Endung an.

bye.de: Auf Wiedersehen. Pass auf deine Finger auf.

bye.en: Go. Tomorrow there is work again.
bye.de: Geh. Morgen gibt es wieder Arbeit.
bye.it: Vai. Domani c'è di nuovo lavoro.

liked.sl: Kako si vedel? Dobro. Hvala, Jan.
liked.en: How did you know? Good. Thanks, Jan.
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Gut. Danke, Jan.
liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Bene. Grazie, Jan.

liked.sl: Ha! Točno to. Tončka bo vesela.
liked.en: Ha! Exactly this. Tončka will be glad.
liked.de: Ha! Genau das. Tončka wird sich freuen.
liked.it: Ah! Proprio questo. Tončka sarà contenta.

ordinary.de: Danke. Du bist in Ordnung, Jan.

ordinary.sl: Hm. Hvala. Daj tja, na mizo.
ordinary.en: Hm. Thanks. Put it there, on the table.
ordinary.de: Hm. Danke. Leg es da hin, auf den Tisch.
ordinary.it: Mm. Grazie. Mettilo lì, sul tavolo.

rare.sl: Hm. To pa … To je lepo, Jan. Res. Hvala.
rare.en: Hm. Well … That's nice, Jan. Really. Thank you.
rare.de: Hm. Also … Das ist schön, Jan. Wirklich. Danke.
rare.it: Mm. Beh … Che bello, Jan. Davvero. Grazie.
